items.title: Etta Jones interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998
items.q: See when I came up we were dancing to Count Basie and Jimmy Lunceford and Andy Kirk.

ctx.x: No, no, no, please don’t. Houston was talking about how he’d love to see people dancing again.
I do too. See when I came up we were dancing to Count Basie and Jimmy Lunceford and Andy Kirk.
Yeah, and I think the musicians got off on that too.
